Thomas Jørgensen is a function-responsible consultant physician (*funktionsansvarlig overlæge*) based at Zealand University Hospital in Køge, Region Zealand [^src1]. He represents the Danish Surgical Society (*Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab*) as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe|Akut Kirurgi Databasen Steering Committee]] [^src1]. 

In this capacity, Jørgensen contributes to the governance of the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB), a national clinical quality database operating under the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP) [^src1]. His role on the steering committee is significant because it provides essential operative and organizational professional support for the database's implementation and clinical quality audits [^src1]. The 2023 AKDB annual report highlights the interdisciplinary and cross-regional structure of this governance body, demonstrating how committee members like Jørgensen help oversee the database's operational realities, including addressing technical registration errors and coding challenges across Denmark's five regions [^src1].
